description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Nether Traitor.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Spirit.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Repeat.
